_about: Giuseppe Mazzini (1805-1872): Life and Writings of Joseph Mazzini, a new edition, 6 vols. (London: Smith, Elder, 1890-1891), his autobiographical notes with the political, critical and literary writings in English (the translator, Emilie Ashurst Venturi, is not named on the title pages). Raw IA OCR, clean 0.92-0.94. Held: An Essay on the Duties of Man (Funk and Wagnalls), because no year is printed in the scan. US public domain. No uids minted.
